en.headline: Police College becomes first government department allowed to award bachelor degrees
en.dek: Commissioner Chow Yat-ming said the free Security and Criminal Investigation (Honours) Bachelor of Policing programme is expected to launch by year-end for serving junior officers.
body: The Hong Kong Police College has become the first government department authorised to award bachelor degrees, Commissioner of Police Chow Yat-ming announced after Saturday’s passing-out parade.

The Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications notified the Force in August that the College could run degree programmes. The free course, titled Security and Criminal Investigation (Honours) Bachelor of Policing, is aimed mainly at serving junior officers without a degree and is expected to take three to four years to complete.

Curriculum elements include language studies, basic training, the standard criminal investigation course, front-line patrol or investigative attachments, and a graduation report. Graduates may later pursue master’s programmes. Chow said further details would be released closer to the expected year-end launch.

zh.headline: 警察學院成首個可頒授學士學位政府部門 年底推免費課程
zh.dek: 警務處長周一鳴在結業會操後公布，學院上月獲評審局通知可頒授學士學位，免費「安保及刑事調查（榮譽）警務學士」課程預計年底推出。
body: 香港警察學院成為首個獲准頒授學士學位的政府部門。警務處處長周一鳴在周六結業會操後會見傳媒時公布，上月收到香港學術及職業資歷評審局通知，學院可開辦學士學位課程。
免費課程名為「安保及刑事調查（榮譽）警務學士學位」，主要面向未有學位的員佐級同事，修讀年期約三至四年。課程包括語文、基礎訓練、標準刑事調查課程、前線巡邏或刑事調查實習，以及專題與畢業報告。
完成後可銜接碩士課程。周一鳴表示，期望最快今年底正式推出，稍後會再作詳細介紹。
